fields.name: lang
fields.label: Language
fields.description: Overrides the <html lang> attribute for this page (e.g. en, es-es, ar-sa). Usually set via the bulk metadata sheet for whole sections; use this field only to override a single page.

fields.name: robots
fields.label: Robots
fields.description: Controls search engine indexing. Leave empty for the default (index, follow). Pages with noindex are also excluded from the sitemap.

fields.name: og:image
fields.label: Social Share Image
fields.description: Overrides the automatic og:image/twitter:image (the page's first image) for social shares.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation Fragment
fields.description: Optional alternative header/nav fragment for this page. Defaults to /nav.

fields.name: footer
fields.label: Footer Fragment
fields.description: Optional alternative footer fragment for this page. Defaults to /footer.

fields.name: site-section
fields.label: Site Section
fields.description: Analytics site_section. Defaults to avg.com when empty.

fields.name: site-sub-section
fields.label: Site Sub Section
fields.description: Analytics site_sub_section. When empty, derived from the URL path.

fields.name: site-sub-sub-section
fields.label: Site Sub Sub Section
fields.description: Analytics site_sub_sub_section. When empty, derived from the URL path.

fields.name: page-name
fields.label: Page Name
fields.description: Overrides the analytics page_name (defaults to the last URL path segment).

fields.name: line-of-business
fields.label: Line of Business
fields.description: Pushed to SDL and dataLayer contentGroup.

fields.name: page-id
fields.label: Page ID
fields.description: Analytics pageId / SDL screenId (AEM jcr:uuid equivalent).

fields.name: analytics
fields.label: Analytics
fields.description: Set to Off to disable all tracking on this page (legal pages).

fields.name: enable-adobe-target-prehiding
fields.label: Enable Adobe Target Pre-hiding
fields.description: When enabled, injects the Adobe Target pre-hiding snippet before Launch.

fields.name: variant-mapping
fields.label: Variant Mapping
fields.description: Optional JSON array for ?expid= overrides, e.g. [{"expIdParam":"v2","pageName":"page-v2","contentTitle":"Title V2"}].
